description: This source file defines the MediaFieldDisplayDriver class, which manages the display and editing of MediaField content within OrchardCore CMS. It includes methods for rendering display views, editing media fields, and updating media field data, handling file attachments, validation, and localization.

classes.name: MediaFieldDisplayDriver
classes.description: A driver class for displaying and editing MediaField content in OrchardCore CMS.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Renders the display view for a MediaField, supporting detail and summary views.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Prepares the editing view for a MediaField, including serialization of media items and setting up the model.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Handles the update process for a MediaField, including validation, file handling, and updating field properties.
